|champion     = Poppy
|skill        = R
|icon         = Keeper's Verdict.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Poppy}} {{tip|channels|charges}} up to a few seconds, increasing the {{sti|range}} and {{tip|airborne|knockback}} distance of her hammer. After a brief period, it becomes empowered with a new effect.
|blurb2      = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Poppy''' swings her hammer, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies nearby and in the area in front of her, briefly {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}}.
|blurb3      = {{sbc|Empowered Recast:}} '''Poppy''' sends a shockwave in the target direction that deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit. Upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, a hammer erupts dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} towards their fountain based on how long she charged up.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Poppy''' {{tip|channels|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Keeper's Verdict's'' {{sti|range}} and {{tip|airborne|knock back}} distance over {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the channel. ''Keeper's Verdict'' can be recast within the duration.
|description2 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Poppy''' releases the charge to launch her hammer upwards, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies nearby and in an area in front of her and {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for 1 second.
|leveling2    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 45% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description3 = If ''Keeper's Verdict'' was charged for at least {{fd|0.5}} seconds, it deals 100% increased damage and enemies hit are {{tip|airborne|knocked back}} {{tt|up-to 3400 units|Scales up to this value over the first 1 second of the channel}} toward the enemy team's [[Spawn|fountain]], during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}} and rendered {{tip|untargetable}}. Additionally, if no enemies are hit {{tt|in front|Same as uncharged radius}} of '''Poppy''', she sends a shockwave that travels in the target direction until it collides with an enemy champion, which causes a hammer to erupt. Targets hit by the shockwave or the eruption receive the charged effects.
|leveling3    = {{st|Increased Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 90% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|description4 = If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} or completes without reactivation, ''Keeper's Verdict'' is cancelled and the ability is put on a {{sti|cd|30-second}} cooldown.
|cooldown     = {{ap|140 to 100}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cast time = {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Uncharged release}}|{{tt|{{fd|0.35}}|Charged release}}}}
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|range        = {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|500|Uncharged range}}|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{pp|type=channel time|850 to 1200 for 3|0.5 to 1|formula=500 + (175 per 0.25 seconds channeled)|changedisplay = true}}}}<!--This 2nd range still needs to be fact checked/improved-->
|width        = {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|180|Both uncharged area and shockwave missile width}}
|speed        = {{tt|2500|Shockwave missile speed}} <!--/ {{tt|X|Knock back speed}}-->
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|180|Uncharged radius around Poppy}}|{{tt|225|Eruption radius upon missile collision}}}}
|targeting    = {{dv|[[Auto-targeted|Auto]]|[[Direction-targeted|Direction]]}}
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Area of effect
|projectile   = True
|silence      = true
|notes        = 
* The erupting hammer of the charged cast that sends out a missile will be centered on the first champion struck, not at the location the missile collided with them.
* Enemies within the enemy team's fountain (at least 400 units away from the {{tt|center of the fountain|the respawning point}}) that are hit by a ''Keeper's Verdict'' that would knock them back are instead {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds and not rendered {{tip|untargetable}}, like the uncharged effect. They still receive the full damage.
* ''Keeper's Verdict'' does not destroy in-flight {{tip|projectile|projectiles}} for enemies hit if they are rendered {{tip|untargetable}}.
* The {{tip|airborne|knock back}} will only displace enemies as far as they can go (e.g. to the furthest current spot available of {{ais|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser}} and {{ais|The Hextech Ultimatum|Camille}} borders and to the corner of the fountain).
** The displacement's duration will remain unchanged regardless of if the knock back cannot achieve its full distance due to the affected target being restricted by boundaries they are unable to cross. In order for this to be possible, the speed of the knock back is decreased (based on where the actual landing point is) to match the amount of distance covered to time spent displaced.
* ''Keeper's Verdict's'' {{tip|airborne}} debuff is non-dispellable and thus cannot be removed by {{tip|cleanse|cleansing}} effects.
** The debuff will remove itself automatically when the forced movement ends.
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} activate after {{fd|0.2}} seconds into the cast time of ''Keeper's Verdict's'' recast. They do not activate if the first cast's channel is interrupted or times out.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Poppy''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|charge|attack=false|move=true|cast=false|items=interrupts, true,, false|spells=true, true, interrupts, interrupts, recasts}}
{{ct|cast|spells=true,false,false,false,false}}
}}
